node.name: Crop_Transfer_Ticket
node.description: Drop this on the Legumulyte (found deep in Bamboo Forest) to trade in ALL your crops for magic beans (Crop Scientist progress wont be lost) Or, hold down on ticket to see how many beans you will get (you wont lose anything doing this)
